snippet.title: Sonic Forces: Rival Rush is Coming Soon to Nex Playground + Play Pass
snippet.description:
Sonic and his friends are dashing onto Play Pass next week in a high-speed, battle racer experience. 

Think you can keep up? Warm up with the teaser and get ready to race!
